description: Four outer-corner shoreline assets for isometric lake edges. Designed to match the previously approved straight shoreline tiles.

assets.meaning: shoreline cap at the north tip of a lake; land continues along upper-left and upper-right sides
shoreline cap at the east tip of a lake; land continues along upper-right and lower-right sides
shoreline cap at the west tip of a lake; land continues along upper-left and lower-left sides
shoreline cap at the south tip of a lake; land continues along lower-left and lower-right sides

notes: These are outer-corner cap tiles, not inner concave corners.
Land width intentionally continues to the tile limits so these connect to straight shoreline tiles without tapering to zero.
